tools.name: search_family_hotels
tools.description: Find family water-holiday hotels & campsites, scored for toddlers, kids and teens. Returns interactive SplashScout cards plus a text summary. Use for prompts like 'best family hotel in Tenerife for a toddler' or 'campsites in France with big slides'.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Show a detailed SplashScout card for one hotel/campsite (age scores, features, our in-person review). Accepts an id or a name.

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description: Compare 2–4 family stays side by side as SplashScout cards, with age scores and features. Accepts ids or names.

labels.name: compare_hotels
labels.description: Compare 2–4 family stays side by side as SplashScout cards, with age scores and features. Accepts ids or names.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_family_hotels" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find family water-holiday hotels & campsites, scored for toddlers, kids and teens. Returns interactive SplashScout cards plus a text summary. Use for prompts like 'best family hotel in Tenerife for a toddler' or 'campsites in France with big slides'." → after: "Find kid-friendly hotels & campsites with pools, slides and splash parks, scored for toddlers, kids and teens. Returns interactive SplashScout cards plus a text summary. Use for prompts like 'best family hotel in Tenerife for a toddler' or 'campsites in France with big slides'."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
